title: Batatis
description: Tired of your regular potatoes ? Well meet Batatis ! ( Potatoes but in Egyptian). Each stage of the batatis gives you different effects and abilities. Additionally, the loaded batatis are just so good to look at and to admire its greatness.
body:
# Batatis - The Better Potatoes !

Got some normal potatoes with garbage saturation and health boost ?

Meet The Batatis Trio !

- Batatis

 ![Batatis Recipe, potato and gold nugget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05e2ca0d7f59eebdd69df0b244add18efba60134.png)
 
- Golden Batatis

 ![Golden Batatis, 8 gold ingots and the batatis in center](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5038868eaf8126d6b966fc1b663b3f8b98d42b4f.png)
 
- Loaded Batatis

![Loaded batatis, golden batatis in center with 8 diamonds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c33910091c9017fa19616ea7764d16ec2a9eaa73.png)

But what do they really offer ? >>>> Cool Effects :D
- Batatis : Water Breathing __bubbles bubblez__
- Golden Batatis : Many cool effects, I just pressed Ctrl A on the good effects ;)

![heatlh boost by golden batatis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/506e618fc651e7b1b555dee8a16a956f682d1f4a.png)
![golden batatis effects](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89e1bb113946affd36be853daccaefd8a580bff9_0.webp)

- Loaded Batatis ( THE ULTIMATE EFFECT ) : IMMUNITY
 
_Litrerally no hostile mob can approach you_

![immunity effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/884e7dd8943ad99d3b09505c5a04f57b609785e8.png)

![loaded batatis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05c7217318276864368b3367ce617345b23d37e7_0.webp)

^^ Just admire the beauty
